starter.title: Coder Docker workspaces
starter.description: Coder’s official Docker workspace template with a persistent home volume.
starter.buildGoal: Prepare the official Coder v2.39.0 Docker workspace template from examples/templates/docker at tag v2.39.0 (include build/Dockerfile). Preserve the coder_agent transport and persistent home volume; do not add account tokens or Happier enrollment secrets to Terraform or startup scripts. Review the template, then import this directory into your Coder deployment. First-user setup and Coder Connected Account sign-in remain separate private steps.
